professionalSummary: Backend engineer with two years of experience on a push notification service, focusing on provider adapters, retry scheduling, staging load testing, and runbook documentation.
experienceHighlights: Developed provider adapters and retry scheduler in development environment with integration tests against provider sandboxes.
Ran synthetic load tests up to 15k messages/sec on staging cluster, capturing latency percentiles and queue depth.
Authored runbook drafts for retry scheduler and hand‑over notes for each release candidate, detailing staging vs production differences and open items for SRE.
Contributed to two years of service operations, including adapter development, retry scheduling, load testing, and documentation.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Load‑test report for release candidate twelve (staging cluster run identifiers).
